headline: "Loans Are Available, But Interest Rates Are Too High"… Even with Total Volume Released, Borrowers Still Don't Feel It [Opening the Loan Gate ③]
summary: Financial authorities doubled the target growth rate for household loans under the 8·13 real estate finance measures and allocated extra limits to banks. End users say the change at loan counters remains limited.
why: Household credit growth and bank lending limits shape South Korea's housing market, consumer demand and banks' loan books.
